blogs.title: Tasty Mediterranean Grilled Chicken Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट भूमध्यसागरीय ग्रील्ड चिकन पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Finger licking grilled chicken with Mediterranean flavors. The lemon juice, oregano adds a nice taste to the chicken.

The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them from the charcoal and the inside is so juicy. This tastes amazing with some mayonnaise or garlic sauce.

 

Mediterranean Grilled Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 50 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Italian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken cut into segments

Onion - 1 large pureed

Red Chilli Flakes - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 2 teaspoon

Black Pepper Powder - 2 teaspoon

Honey - 3 to 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Lemon Juice - 4 tablespoons

Olive Oil - 4 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Take all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Add in chicken and leave to marinate overnight.

The next day, cook it in a charcoal barbeque grill.

You can cook in regular over as well. Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Bake for 35 to 40 mins. Remove and broil for 2 to 3 mins.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Baked Chicken Cream Cheese Dip Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट बेक्ड चिकन क्रीम चीज़ डिप रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious chicken cream cheese dip which tastes amazing for parties or get-togethers. This is not only easy to make but taste amazing.

This is a great party recipe. You can make a big batch of it and enjoy it as a dip for parties.

 

Chicken Cream Cheese Dip Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: American

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Leftover Cooked Chicken - 1 cup shredded

Cream Cheese - ½ cup

Mozzarella Cheese - 1 cup

Mayonnaise - 3 tablespoon

Black pepper - ½ teaspoon

Relish - 1 tablespoon

Spring Onion - 4 tablespoons chopped finely

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients together, spoon into a baking dish and smoothen the top.

Bake in a 200 degree C. preheated oven for 15 to 20 mins.

Serve it with chips or pita bread.

blogs.title: Chicken Omelette ( Leftover Chicken ) Recipes
blogs.content:
Healthy chicken omelette which is not only delicious but is very easy to make. You can serve it with rice or enjoy on its own.

 

Chicken Omelette Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 5 mins

Total time: 15 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 1 serving

 

Ingredients

Eggs - 3

Cooked Chicken - 1 cup shredded

Onion - 1 sliced thinly

Curry leaves a sprig

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Coriander leaves - ¼ cup chopped finely

Oil for making an omelette

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pan. Pour the mix in and cook for 2 mins on low heat. Flip over and cook.

Serve it hot.

blogs.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Fritters Recipe
blogs.content:
This delicious chicken fritter is super easy to make and taste amazing. You can make this in a few minutes and kids will love this for sure.

 

Chicken Fritters Recipe

Prep time: 5 mins

Cook time: 5 mins

Total time: 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Cooked Chopped Chicken - 1 cup

Carrot - ¼ cup chopped finely

Capsicum - ¼ cup chopped finely

Egg - 1

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - ½ cup

Cheese - ½ cup grated

Water as needed

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Oil - for shallow frying

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients together.

Heat oil in a pan. Spoon some mix in and cook till golden on both sides.

Serve it hot with ketchup.

blogs.title: Tasty Varutharacha Nattu Kozhi Curry Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी वरूथराचा नट्टू कोज़ी करी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
The super delicious chicken curry which is not only easy to make but is so yummy. This taste amazing with some rice or roti.

This is a simple chicken curry made using fresh spices and ground coconut. This chicken dish is so easy to make, you need basic ingredients. If you use small chicken pieces then it will be tastier.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Nattu kozhi / Country chicken - 1 kg

Onion - 3 large sliced thinly

Coconut Oil - 4 tablespoon

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 tsp

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 4

Cloves / Krambu - 4

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoon

Tomatoes - 4 large chopped finely

Chilli powder - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Powder - 2 tablespoon

Turmeric powder - 1 teaspoon

Cumin powder - 2 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 tablespoon

Potato - 2 large peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

 

FOR ROASTING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Dry Red Chillies - 6

Coriander Seeds / Malli - 2 tablespoon

Coconut - 1 cup

 

Instructions

Take chicken in a pressure cooker, add salt and turmeric powder and pressure cook for 5 to 6 whistle. Turn off the heat and let it sit till steam escapes.

Heat oil in a pan, add coriander seeds and chillies and saute till toasted.

Add coconut and saute till it gets golden.

Take it in a blender and make it into a smooth paste.

Heat oil in a pan, add whole spices and let them sizzle.

Add ginger-garlic paste and saute for a min.

Add onions and cook till golden.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add spice powders and salt and mix well.

Add in cooked chicken and mix well.

Add ground masala, salt and mix well.

Cook till oil separates.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Soupy Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.content:
The delicious soupy chicken curry which tastes so delicious with some hot rice or some Paratha or roti. This can be made using nattu kozhi chicken as well.

This is a simple chicken curry made using fresh spices. This chicken dish is so easy to make, you need basic ingredients. If you use small chicken pieces then it will be tastier. It has a little saucy texture and tastes amazing.

 

Soupy Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 50 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - 3 tablespoon

Onion - 2 large

Garlic - 5 cloves

Tomato - 2 large pureed

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Kashmiri Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Black Pepper Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chicken - 500 grams

Coriander Leaves - 3 tablespoons chopped finely

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pressure cooker.

Grind onion and garlic till coarse.

Add in onion puree and saute for 5 mins.

Add in the tomato puree and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in spice powders and salt and mix well.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Add water and cover and cook for 2 whistles for normal chicken and 6 whistles for country chicken.

Take it off the heat and let the steam escape by itself.

Add in pepper powder and coriander leaves.

Serve it over rice.

blogs.title: Tasty Oven Baked ( Juicy Baked ) Fried Chicken Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवन बेक्ड (रसदार बेक्ड) फ्राइड चिकन रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Healthy crispy fried chicken which actually tastes like fried chicken. It is healthier and is more juicer than normal ones. Serve it with a side salad and you are good to go.

 

Oven-Baked Fried Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: American

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken cut into 10 pieces

Dried Basil - 1 tablespoon

Dried Oregano -1 tablespoon

Cayenne Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 1 tablespoon

Onion Powder - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Oil - 2 tablespoon

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Egg - 2

 

Instructions

Take all spices and salt in a bowl and mix well.

Take chicken in a bowl, add half of the seasoning mix in the chicken and mix well.

Take breadcrumbs in a bowl and add the remaining half of the spices in it.

Beat eggs in a bowl.

Take chicken and dip in egg, coat in breadcrumbs and arrange in a foil-lined baking pan.

Drizzle little oil over the chicken.

Pop it in a 200-degree c, preheated oven for 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Udon Chicken Noodles Soup Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी उडोन चिकन नूडल्स सूप रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious hot and sour chicken soup with those thick udon noodles. It is so filling and is so delicious too. You can enjoy this soup on cold days.

 

Udon Chicken Noodles Soup Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Soup

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Udon Noodles - 100 grams

Chicken with Bones - 500 grams

Carrot - 1 grated

Cabbage - 1 cup chopped finely

Soya Sauce - 2 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Sugar - 1 teaspoon

Vinegar to taste

Cornflour / Cornstarch - 1 tablespoon

Black Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Cook udon noodles as per package directions. Drain them and divide it between serving bowls.

Take chicken in a pot, cover with water and cook till chicken is tender.

Now drain the chicken and remove flesh from it.

Now add carrot and cabbage to the chicken and cook till the veggies are done.

Add salt, soy sauce, sugar, pepper, and vinegar.

Add in cornflour mixed with little water. Mix well so the soup gets thick.

Now Pour the soup over the noodles and serve.

blogs.title: Tasty Baked Baked Murgh ( Chicken ) Badami Kebab Recipe
blogs.title_hi: टेस्टी बेक्ड बेक्ड मुरग (चिकन) बादामी कबाब रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious badam chicken which is baked to perfection and is finger-licking good. This not only tastes amazing but is super succulent.

 

Baked Badam Chicken Kebab Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 kg cut into pieces

Badam - 50 grams

Cream - ¼ cup

Kasuri methi leaves - 2 tablespoon

Green chilies - 6

Mint leaves - 1 cup

Coriander leaves - 1 cup

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoon

Curd / Yogurt - ¼ cup

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

Lemon Juice - 4 tablespoon

Oil - ¼ cup

 

Instructions

Make deep slashes on chicken.

Grind all ingredients together to a smooth paste

Pour over chicken and mix well. Leave to marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight.

Arrange in a baking tray and bake for 45 mins. Flip in between and continue baking,

Serve it hot.

blogs.title: Homemade Chicken Pot Pie Recipe
blogs.title_hi: घर का बना चिकन पॉट पाई पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
This is a delicious chicken pot pie that tastes amazing for either a light lunch or dinner. This is so much easier and simple to make at home and kids will love it.

 

Chicken Pot Pie Recipe - Homemade Chicken Pie From Scratch

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 1 hour

Total time: 1 hour 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Greece

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR PASTRY:

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 1 cup

Cold Butter - 50 grams cubed

Salt to taste

Cold Water as needed

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Butter - 1 tablespoon

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Dried Rosemary - 1 teaspoon

Cayenne Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 tablespoon

 

FOR FILLING:

Butter - 2 tablespoon

Garlic - 1 tablespoon minced

Onion - 1 chopped finely

Carrot - 1 chopped finely

Bell Pepper - 1 chopped finely

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 tablespoon

Milk - 2 cups

Frozen Peas - ½ cup

Chopped Parsley or Coriander - 2 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Make pastry dough. Take flour in a bowl. Add salt and mix well.

Add in butter and rub it into the flour. Add cold water and shape it into a dough. Chill in the fridge for 1 hour.

Mix chicken with rosemary, salt, all-purpose flour, and cayenne.

Heat oil and butter in a pan, fry chicken till golden brown. Remove and set aside.

Heat more butter in the same pan, add garlic, onion, carrot, and peppers. Saute for a min.

Add in flour, salt, pepper and mix well.

Add milk and mix well.

Add in chicken and frozen peas and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Add chopped parsley and mix well.

Now cool this mix. Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Take a portion of the dough and roll it into a sheet.

Spoon it into individual pan and top with the rolled pastry sheet,'Make holes in the top. seal the edges.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 25 to 30 mins till golden.

Remove and serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Majestic ( Masala Coated ) Recipe
blogs.content:
Delicious chicken majestic which is Hyderabadi famous street food. This tastes amazing on its own or as a side dish for rice.

 

Chicken Majestic Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Curd or Plain Yogurt - 3 tablespoon

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Egg - 1

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 3 tablespoon

Cornflour - 3 tablespoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Pepper Powder - 1 teaspoon

Cumin Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Turmeric powder - ½ teaspoon

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR MASALA:

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Curry leaves a handful

Garlic Paste - 1 teaspoon

Green Chillies - 2 chopped

Chilli Powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam Masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Turmeric powder - ½ teaspoon

Curd / Plain Yogurt - 2 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Soy Sauce - to taste

Black Pepper powder - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Mix chicken with salt and yogurt and leave to marinate for 30 mins to overnight.

Add all the ingredients. Marinate chicken with all things listed for marination.

Heat oil for pan-frying. Drop chicken and fry till golden.

Drain and set aside.

Heat oil in a pan. Add garlic, curry leaves, and chilies and saute.

Add spice powders and curd. Mix well.,

Add fried chicken and mix well. Add pepper powder and soy sauce.

Serve it hot.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Hand ( Pocket ) Pies Recipe
blogs.content:
Super delicious chicken hand pie which is easy to make at home than buying from a shop. It will be a great appetizer or light lunch for any parties too.

 

Chicken Hand Pies Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 1 hour

Total time: 1 hour 10 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Greece

Serves: 6 to 8 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR PASTRY:

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 1 cup

Cold Butter - 50 grams cubed

Salt to taste

Cold Water as needed

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Butter - 1 tablespoon

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Dried Rosemary - 1 teaspoon

Cayenne Powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 tablespoon

 

FOR FILLING:

Butter - 2 tablespoon

Garlic - 1 tablespoon minced

Onion - 1 chopped finely

Carrot - 1 chopped finely

Bell Pepper - 1 chopped finely

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - 2 tablespoon

Milk - 2 cups

Frozen Peas - ½ cup

Chopped Parsley or Coriander - 2 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Make pastry dough. Take flour in a bowl. Add salt and mix well.

Add in butter and rub it into the flour. Add cold water and shape it into a dough. Chill in the fridge for 1 hour.

Mix chicken with rosemary, salt, all-purpose flour, and cayenne.

Heat oil and butter in a pan, fry chicken till golden brown. Remove and set aside.

Heat more butter in the same pan, add garlic, onion, carrot, and peppers. Saute for a min.

Add in flour, salt, pepper and mix well.

Add milk and mix well.

Add in chicken and frozen peas and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Add chopped parsley and mix well.

Now cool this mix. Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Take a portion of the dough and roll it into a small round

Place the filling and fold it and seal the edges.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 25 to 30 mins till golden.

Remove and serve.

blogs.title: Tasty Lemon Pepper Chicken Recipe
blogs.content:
Delicious lemon pepper chicken tastes amazing with either fried rice or noodles. This tastes so yummy and is very easy to make.

This is a delicious and easy side made using chicken. This Chinese style chicken dish tastes fantastic with any Chinese dish or even plain rice. You can make this dry and serve it as an appetizer.

 

Lemon Pepper Chicken Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 25 mins

Total time: 35 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Boneless Chicken - 500 grams

Salt to taste

Black Pepper to taste

Egg - 1

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - ¼ cup

Cornflour - ¼ cup

Oil for shallow frying

Get Ingredients Powered by Chicory

 

FOR SAUCE:

Lemon Juice - 3 tablespoons

Soy Sauce - 3 tablespoons

Garlic - 2 teaspoons grated

Salt to taste

Sugar - 1 tablespoon

Black Pepper - 1 teaspoon

Cornflour - 1 teaspoon

Water - ½ cup

 

Instructions

Mix chicken in a bowl. Add other ingredients and mix well.

Heat oil in a pan. Add chicken and fry till golden. Drain and set aside.

Mix all sauce ingredients.

Add in sauce ingredients and mix well. Simmer for 3 to 5 mins.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Vepudu Guntur Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.title_hi: तास्ति रोस्ट गुंटूर चिकन करी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Delicious and juicy chicken stir fry which is also called chicken vepudu. This is super yummy and tastes amazing with some rice and rasam.

This is a spicy chicken dish that tastes fantastic. It is spicy and delicious. This tastes amazing even with some pulao, biryani as well. You can even serve it with some roti or paratha too. But I enjoy it thoroughly with some rasam rice.

 

Vepudu Guntur Chicken Curry

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR CHICKEN:

Chicken - 500 grams with bone

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Lemon Juice - 3 tablespoons

Oil for deep frying

 

FOR MASALA:

Oil - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large sliced

Curry Leaves a handful

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Tomato - 2 chopped

Salt to taste

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Coriander Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli Powder - 1 tablespoon

Cumin powder - 1 teaspoon

Garam masala powder - 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

Water - 1 cup

 

Instructions

Take chicken in a bowl, add all ingredients except oil and mix well.

Deep fry chicken till golden. Drain and set aside.

Heat little oil in a pan. Add in onion, curry leaves, ginger garlic paste and mix well.

Add tomatoes and mix well.

Add salt, spice powders, water and mix well.

Once the gravy is done. Add chicken and mix well.

Cover and cook till chicken is dry.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Kongunadu Kozhi Kuzhambu ( Kongu Style ) Chicken Curry Recipe
blogs.title_hi: तस्सती कोंगुनाडु कोजही कुजाम्बु (कोंगु स्टाइल) चिकन करी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Super spicy and fragrant chicken curry made kongu style with fresh spice powder and potato. This is not only easy to make but taste amazing.

This is a spicy chicken dish that tastes fantastic. It is spicy and delicious. This tastes amazing even with some pulao, biryani as well. You can even serve it with some roti or paratha too. But I enjoy it thoroughly with some rasam rice.

 

Kongunadu Kozhi Kuzhambu Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

 

FOR THE SPICE MIX

Dry Red Chillies - 100 grams

Coriander Seeds - 300 grams

Cumin Seeds - 25 grams

Black Pepper - 25 grams

 

FOR CURRY:

Gingelly Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel Seeds / Sombu - 1 tsp

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 small stick

Cardamom / Yelakai - 3

Cloves / Krambu - 3

Onion - 1 large sliced thinly

Green Chillies - 2

Ginger Garlic Paste - 1 tablespoon

Tomato - 2 chopped finely

Kuzhambu Milagai Thool - 3 to 4 tablespoon (recipe above)

Salt to taste

Chicken - ½ kg

Potato - 1 large peeled and cubed

Water as needed

 

Instructions

Sundry the spices for a day and grind it in a blender till fine. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pan. Add whole spices and let them sizzle.

Add onions, chilies and saute till light brown.

Add ginger-garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in spice powders and salt and mix well.

Add in chicken and mix well.

Add water. Cover and cook for 20 mins.

Add potatoes and cook for another 15 mins.

Serve it.
